Messages.Author: Luis Duarte
Messages.Body:
Deck name: Euro-Sabbat
Type: S&B
Description: there is only one european Sabbat Archbishop. If you
was expecting something really efficient, try the Camarilla
Euro-Brujah...! :)

Crypt:
12 Marconius, 9, Kiasyd, DOM+OBT+MYT+pot, Archbishop of Strasbourg, <specials>

Library:

Masters:
2 Blood Doll
2 Minion Tap
2 Secure Haven
3 Dreams of the Sphinx
1 Archon Investigation

Actions:
10 Govern the Unaligned (bleed)
4 Steal the Mind (+2 intercept)
2 Eternal Vigilance (untap to block)

Action Modifiers:
6 Stone Travel (+1 stealth/S:CE)
8 Shadow Play (+2 stealth)
6 Shroud of Night (+1 stealth)
6 Aura Absorption (+1 stealth/+1 intercept)

Combat:
8 Oubliette
2 Entombment

Reaction:
4 WWEF
3 Forced Awakening
4 Deflection
5 Folderol

[This deck is obviously a joke...]
